comment: Cross-impl parity vectors for reserve tool-loop-headroom classification. Regenerate via: cd proto/go && go test ./inject -run TestToolGrowthVectors -update. Loaded by proto/go/inject/toolgrowth_vectors_test.go and proto/ts/test/tool-growth-vectors.test.ts.

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: no_tools
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: no tools field at all

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: empty_tools
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: empty array cannot grow anything

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: malformed
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: unparseable body reports false; the node's input-budget check backstops

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: tools_not_array
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: non-array tools is not a tools list

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: function_only
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: caller-executed: the harness runs it and re-issues a separately-measured request

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: many_functions
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: the coding-agent case: MCP servers expanded client-side into plain function tools

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: bare_function_no_type
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: no type: a bare function entry is still caller-executed

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: local_shell
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: caller-executed by name

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: apply_patch
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: caller-executed by name

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: computer_use
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: normalizes to computer_use; the caller's harness performs the actions

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: anthropic_bash_dated
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: the _YYYYMMDD suffix normalizes away to bash, which is caller-executed

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: shell_local_env
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: environment.type local folds onto local_shell — runs on the caller's machine

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: zs_builtin
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: node built-in: the NODE runs the chat->tool->chat loop in-process

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: zs_builtin_among_functions
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: one growth-driving tool anywhere in the list is enough

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: vendor_web_search
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: vendor-hosted: the upstream re-prefills results into the context

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: vendor_code_interpreter
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: vendor-hosted

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: vendor_mcp
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: hosted-but-free still inflates context — the per-call fee is a separate axis

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: moonshot_builtin_function
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: Moonshot spelling: the identifying name is the $-prefixed function name

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: shell_hosted_env
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: vendor-managed container: the upstream executes it

body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.name: unknown_hosted_type
body_drives_server_side_tool_growth.why: default-deny: an unrecognized hosted type is assumed to grow context
